Name: StarAmys Museum Valley 1.6
Author: StarAmy
Description:
[i][size=4]Some new content, and some old content ripped from 1.5 version of Elegant Valley that I thought fit nicely here!

~Amy[/size][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t6N1iNR.png[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fvzIB23.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Museum and Trinket Storage Shed[/size][/b][size=5][b]***NEW[/b]
[/size][size=3]Display all of your various collected and crafted trinkets and treasures in style. Includes lots of rooms, lots of wall space, and an optional extra large back room for the serious collector.[/size]
[b][size=3][b]Config Options:
[/b][/size][/b][size=3][list]
[*]Replacement: "Shed, Big Shed"
[*]Version: "Small, Large"
[*]Built In Extras: "On, Off"
[/list][/size]
[b][size=4]Museum Furniture[/size][size=5]***NEW[/size][/b]
[size=3]A mix of regular vanilla table displays and functional display framework pieces to liven up any museum or display. Requires Content Patcher, or find Furniture Framework version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24224]HERE[/url]﻿ (thanks, Ashrayne!).
[/size][size=3][b]Includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gold Info Wall Sign
[*]Black Info Wall Sign
[*]Gold Info Floor Sign
[*]Black Info Floor Sign
[*]Gold Info Sign on Stand
[*]Black Info Sign on Stand
[*]Marble Pedestal
[*]Small Museum Stand
[*]Small Museum Stand with Cover
[*]Small Museum Stand Glass Front
[*]Large Museum Stand
[*]Large Museum Stand with Cover
[*]Large Museum Stand Glass Front
[*]Large Enclosed Display Stand
[*]Large Enclosed Display Stand Front
[*]Museum Shadowbox
[*]Museum Shadowbox Glass Front
[*]Trophy Case
[*]Trophy Case Front
[*]Small Scientific Poster
[*]Large Scientific Poster
[/list][b]NEW 1.2.0 Ancient History Update
[/b][list]
[*]Fossil Slab
[*]Framed Fossil
[*]Framed Map
[*]Small, Med, and Lg Fossil Tables
[*]Small, and Med Map Tables
[*]Fossil Wallpaper and Flooring
[/list][/size]
[b][size=4]Functional Inset Wall Shelves[/size][/b][b] [/b][size=3]***Reworked from [b]same [/b]- new wood colors[/size]
[size=3]Display any vanilla game object in style. Now in four different wood colors, all available from Robin at the carpenter's. Requires Content Patcher and Furniture Display Framework.[/size]

[b][size=4]Decorative Inset Wall Shelves[/size][/b][b] [/b][size=3]***Reworked from [b]same [/b]- new wood colors, new crystal shelf[/size]
[size=3]A variety of pre-decorated shelves for your home or business space. Now in four different Wood colors, all available from Robin at the Carpenter's. Requires Functional Inset Wall Shelves and Alternative Textures. [/size]

[b][size=4]Shelving Wallpapers[/size][size=5]***NEW(ish)[/size][/b][b] [/b][size=3]***Reworked from [b]Utility Wallpapers[/b][/size]
[size=3]Empty wall shelving, along with ones filled with books, bottles, and crystals. The empty ones align perfectly with both Inset Wall Shelves sets above for infinite decorating potential. Requires Content Patcher and Custom Wallpaper Framework OR Alternative Textures to add them as new options.[/size]

[b][size=4]Picture Perfect Wallpapers [/size][/b][b][size=5]***NEW[/size][/b]
[size=3]A variety of prints and pictures to fill up your walls. Six different prints in six different background colors. Requires Content Patcher and Custom Wallpaper Framework OR Alternative Textures to add them as new options.[/size]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/WMtMyZ6.png[/img]

[size=4]None at the moment, so please report any you encounter! Be sure to include your SMAPI log via [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] when possible.
[/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/XvsLXvi.png[/img]

[size=3][b]My building/furniture/object reskins don’t show up in game even though I have the right mods installed.[/b]
There’s a pretty good chance something else is patching the same sprites and winning the fight. You can use Content Patcher’s terminal commands to quickly find the cause of the problem in most cases, and then disable the conflicting mod or specific patch. 

[b]Where do I find the extra new wallpapers and floors added using Content Patcher/Custom Wallpaper Framework? They don't appear at shops or in the CJB Item Spawner.
[/b]Correct! You'll need to access them using the wallpaper catalogue, so buy one of those first.

[b]How do I change through Alternative Texture skins for an object or building? 
[/b]You'll want the Paint Bucket, bought from Robin at the Carpenter's.

[b]Why have my Farm Type Manager items stopped spawning over time?
[/b]Try deleting the files inside of the "data" folder in the mod, that sometimes fixes it.[/size]
